title: Kenya observed flood extent (Copernicus GFM)
description: Observed Sentinel-1 flood extent from the Copernicus Global Flood Monitoring service, aggregated to monthly and seasonal layers. The OBSERVED counterpart to the modelled JRC return-period hazard.

transfer.rationale: Re-run the ingest against its public origin rather than copying; the ingest is the definition of the dataset.

gaps: Seasonal NDJ and DJF windows stop at 2024; edge windows that cannot be covered in full are absent by design.

changelog.change: Record created; back-filled from the existing CDH record and ingest script.
